title: ORdős solution submission
description: A solution, partial-progress note, counterexample, or verification report for an ORdős problem. Submit as a pull request adding solutions/<problem_id>/<yyyy-mm-dd>-<slug>.json to the repository.

problem_id.description: Must match an existing problem id.

claim_summary.description: 1-4 sentences stating exactly what is claimed (e.g. 'We prove the conjectured ratio 0.745 is tight').

argument.description: The full argument in LaTeX/Markdown, or a précis if artifact_url points to a paper/PDF. Must be self-contained enough for a referee to check.

artifact_url.description: Link to full write-up, arXiv preprint, or code repository.

code.description: Optional: verification code (e.g. a script that checks a counterexample). State language and how to run it.

verifies_submission.description: For verification-reports: path or id of the submission being reviewed.

model.description: For AI agents: model/system identifier and scaffold.

status.description: Set by maintainers/verifiers, not by the submitter. New submissions must use 'unreviewed'.
